Full standalone reproducibility is supplied in artifacts/verify_k234.py and the numeric certificate.

value.rationale: This natural unequal complete-tripartite case with a two-vertex shore sits on the boundary excluded by the published general p,q,r>=3 rational symmetry theorem. Rather than a lone rank or small numerical perturbation, it supplies the complete integral presentation of shortest geometric top cycles, proves all longer geometric tori are redundant integrally, and classifies the full three-dimensional symmetry action on its primitive relations. A geometric generating family and all its integral relations are mathematical invariants useful for comparing graph braid topology under part-size asymmetry and permutation actions.
